seo.title: AI Development | Mohit Walia
seo.description: Product features that use a model for a specific job: drafts, search, classification, or support, with a way to review the output.

hero.heading: AI features with a job, a boundary, and a review.
hero.subtitle: I add model-backed features to a product you already have, or build the small product around one. The model is a worker, not the whole company.

overview: Useful AI work is a narrow task with examples, a prompt or a tool call, and a place for a human to correct it. I build that into your product instead of a disconnected chat window.
problem: A chatbot is added because it is expected. It answers with confidence, cannot see your data, and nobody knows when it is wrong.
solution: I define the task, connect only the data that task needs, and show the output where a person can accept or edit it. Logs tell you what the model did.

features.title: A single job
features.detail: Draft, classify, extract, or answer from your own content. Not an open-ended persona.

features.title: Your content, not the public internet
features.detail: The model sees the documents or records you choose.

features.title: A review step
features.detail: Someone can correct the output before it reaches a customer, when that matters.

process.title: Discovery
process.detail: We pin down the outcome, the constraints, and what the first release has to do.

process.title: Planning
process.detail: I turn that into a scope, a sequence, and the technical approach.

process.title: Development
process.detail: I build in small slices you can review, on the stack this service uses.

process.title: Testing
process.detail: We check the flows that matter before anything is treated as finished.

process.title: Launch
process.detail: I ship it, watch the first days, and leave you with a clear way to change it.

benefits.title: You can tell if it works
benefits.detail: The task has examples, so quality is visible.

benefits.title: Costs stay bounded
benefits.detail: Calls are tied to a feature, not an unlimited chat.

benefits.title: It lives in the product
benefits.detail: Users do not leave the workflow to paste text into another tool.

deliverables: Notes on how to change the task

timeline.detail: Examples of good and bad output, and the data the model may see.
The feature, the review UI, and the logs.
A pass on real examples before it is the default.

faqs.question: Which model do you use?
faqs.answer: OpenAI or Claude, chosen for the task and the budget. The product code does not depend on a single vendor more than it has to.

faqs.question: Will it train on our data?
faqs.answer: I use the provider APIs in a way that sends only what the feature needs. We confirm the provider's data terms before launch.
